reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model 'RGV 16 Kids Bike'. That is not a recalled model; the recalled models are REV 12, REV 16 and REV 20 Kids Bike. The label reading controls over the typed model.
The typed serial 07VX50697893 falls in a recalled range and the date code 2022 is in range, but these do not cure a non-recalled model.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (REI.com) within the sale window, and no duplicate claims were found, so these checks do not change the denial.
